document: MBT Kampo Cross-Source Structural Reconciliation v1.0
reason: The exact kampo_metabolic_library.json file is not present in the currently accessible active file set. Prior source material contains its schema/examples, but not the complete canonical JSON dataset.
source_B: HealthBook_MIOS_Migration_Package_v1.0(1).json and prior MBT JSON schema material

reconciliation_rows.finding: Inventory contains 39 dedicated herb candidates; overview claims 38. Exact B-side entity count/content is not currently available in the active file set.
reconciliation_rows.decision: Do not canonicalize count; resolve herb identity/alias first.

reconciliation_rows.finding: 芍薬 and 白芍 appear as distinct source assets; prior JSON example also treats herb_byakujutsu etc. as distinct IDs but does not establish canonical identity rules.
reconciliation_rows.decision: Create Herb Identity Resolution rule before merge.

reconciliation_rows.finding: 19 individual Markdown formula assets; overview states 20; Excel contains F001-F151 range.
reconciliation_rows.decision: Treat Markdown, stated count, and Excel as separate source populations until exact JSON is supplied.

reconciliation_rows.source_A: MBT漢方代謝ライブラリー.xlsx
reconciliation_rows.source_B: 漢方代謝ライブラリー１.xlsx
reconciliation_rows.finding: Two Excel assets overlap in F001/F012 examples but have materially different scope: one contains 151-ID sheets, the other is a small overlapping dataset.
reconciliation_rows.decision: Excel lineage/version comparison required before canonical formula registry.

reconciliation_rows.finding: ZIP contains 7 Sho assets including 和解; prior JSON example lists six primary Sho values in its HealthBook UI and comments, while some data includes 和解.
reconciliation_rows.decision: Canonical Sho vocabulary must explicitly decide whether 和解 is a first-class class.

reconciliation_rows.finding: ZIP has 19 symptom files; prior JSON example lists a larger conceptual symptom set than the overview's 12-category claim.
reconciliation_rows.decision: Use actual source entities, then distinguish category taxonomy from individual symptoms.
Preserve both provenance records; resolve identity after content comparison.

reconciliation_rows.finding: Both use MetaboliteCluster as a first-class object; exact member lists and semantics require content-level reconciliation.
reconciliation_rows.decision: Retain cluster as source concept; map later to MIOS canonical Metabolite/FunctionalCluster ontology.

reconciliation_rows.finding: Both model MBT55 paths and their relations to metabolites, herbs, Sho and symptoms.
reconciliation_rows.decision: Reconcile terminology to MIOS Essential Microbial Functions; do not equate pathway labels with validated microbial taxa.

reconciliation_rows.finding: Prior JSON explicitly defines network_maps with Mermaid content and formula linkage.
reconciliation_rows.decision: Treat diagrams as derived knowledge/provenance assets, not independent canonical facts.

reconciliation_rows.finding: Source library contains mechanistic/clinical language, but the inventory phase does not establish external validation.
reconciliation_rows.decision: Every claim must enter Evidence Registry with provenance and evidence status before clinical use.

reconciliation_rows.finding: Kampo Formula, Metabolite, Microbial Function, Symptom, Food/Phytochemical and Evidence are explicit MIOS KG node classes; edge model supports transforms/produces/signals/evidence.
reconciliation_rows.decision: Kampo asset can become a governed MIOS Knowledge Asset after reconciliation.

critical_findings: 19 Markdown formula assets vs stated 20 vs Excel F001-F151 population.
7 Sho assets vs documentation/UI examples centered on 6.
19 symptom assets vs smaller overview category claims.
芍薬 / 白芍 identity-resolution candidate.
Two Excel datasets have overlapping examples but different scope.
MBT55 pathway labels are structurally compatible with MIOS Microbial Function modeling, but are not themselves evidence of validated microbial taxa or causal efficacy.
Exact 293/294 issue cannot be resolved from this source set because the complete kampo_metabolic_library.json dataset is unavailable.
next_required_input: Upload or expose the complete kampo_metabolic_library.json to execute entity-level bidirectional reconciliation.
